# Packages whose tests run the go tool to build or run a program (go build, go run, ...), or run
# node, bash or sh over files of the tree. go test reuses an unchanged package's cached result, and
# cannot see such a program or script change, so CI runs these
# packages with -count=1 (.github/scripts/shards.sh run) and every other package from the test
# cache. One package directory per line, relative to the repository root.
# .github/scripts/check-uncached.sh (Lint) fails when a test file that runs the go tool for more than
# "go list" and "go mod" is in a package missing here, and when an entry has no such test.
approvals
cmd/bide
cmd/bide/bide-hsm
cmd/bide/internal/initcmd
examples/approval
examples/plan
examples/stripe-refund
integration/bideaudit
internal/auditcli
model/provider
